name: HOT3D
tagline: 833 min of Aria + Quest 3 multi-view ego video: 19 people handling 33 scanned objects, with mocap-grade 3D hand and 6-DoF object poses.

annotations.format: VRS + JSONL/CSV (full dataset); per-frame JSON inside tar clips (HOT3D-Clips)
annotations.coverageNote: 1.16M of 1.5M multi-view frames passed QA with full hand+object poses (77%); HOT3D-Clips: 3,832 fully annotated 150-frame clips (2,804 train, 1,028 test).

object_boxes.note: Amodal 2D boxes per camera stream for hands and objects (HOT3D-Clips)

segmentation.note: Amodal (rendered) and modal (SAM2) object masks per stream (HOT3D-Clips)

hand_pose.note: MANO (thetas + wrist xform) and UmeTrack (20 joint angles) per frame, mocap GT

object_pose.note: 6-DoF T_world_from_object per frame + 33 PBR-scanned GLB meshes

camera_pose.note: T_world_from_camera per stream per frame; headset trajectory

samples.caption: Aria RGB + mono views with GT hand and object outlines, and the 3D scene with point cloud and poses
